title: roro sakina kehti thi amma neend nahi aati
body:
roro sakina kehti thi amma neend nahi aati
yaad aati hain baba ki amma neend nahi aati
1. shaam-e-ghareeba aayi hain dard ke manzar layi hai
kaisi qayamat chahi hain charo taraf tanhaai hai
ek-ek lamha hai bhari amma neend nahi aati
<<DIVIDER>>
2. aag hai kurte mein amma kano se hain khoon rawan
chaya hai ankhon mein dhuwa bolo mere aamu hain kaha
mere gale mein hain rassi amma neend nahi aati
<<DIVIDER>>
3. jab bhi tamache khati hoon dard se chakra jati hoon
khauf se main ghabrati hoon sonch ke yeh tharrati hoon
duniya meri barbaad huwi amma neend nahi aati
<<DIVIDER>>
4. chod gaye humko baba maare gaye hain mere chacha
kaun chudane ayega dum ghutta hai ab mera
dil pa mere chalti hain churi amma neend nahi aati
<<DIVIDER>>
5. mujh se qismat ruthi hai zindan mein khamoshi hai
yeh kaisi tareeki hai har dum rokar kehti hai
din nikla ya raat huwi amma neend nahi aati
<<DIVIDER>>
6. baba ko jab paungi gaal apne dikhlaon gi
haal apna batlaungi seeney par sojaongi
neend hai mujh se roothi amma neend nahi aati
<<DIVIDER>>
7. mujhko tamache hain mare gaal hai mere sujhe huwe
kaan mere zakhmi karke cheene gaye mere bundhe
roz jafa hoti hain nayi amma neend nahi aati
<<DIVIDER>>
8. qaid mein kabtak rehna hain dukh ye kab tak sehna hai
dur watan mein behna hain kis se gham yeh kehna hai
hogi rehaai kab meri amma neend nahi aati
<<DIVIDER>>
9. har lamha hain ranjo mehan sujha huwa hain mera dahan
zakhmi hain ab mera badan zinda mein hoti hain ghutan
koun sune rudaad meri amma neend nahi aati
<<DIVIDER>>
10. baba mere ab ayenge zindaan se chudwayenge
seene se liptayenge hum apne ghar jayenge
sonchti rehti hoon mein yahi amma neend nahi aati
<<DIVIDER>>
11. zakhmi lasha qasim ka akber ka zakhmi seena
khoonme bhara wo mashkiza baba ka besar lasha
manzar hai ankhon mein sabhi amma neend nahi aati
<<DIVIDER>>
12. pyass ka hai mujh par yeh asar dhundhla gayi hai meri nazar
saans bhi lagti hai nishtar phat-ta hai sadme se jigar
hoti hai takleef badi amma neend nahi atti
<<DIVIDER>>
13. baap ke sar se lipti huwi bain jo karti thi bachi
ahle haram rote the sabhi maut ki jab ayyi hichki
shikwe the hotoun pe yahi amma neend nahi aati
<<DIVIDER>>
14. kaise likhe razvi-o-nazar dil pe chale kitne khanjar
kaise sunti thi maadar bali sakina jab rokar
indaan mein kehti thi yahi amma neend nahi aati
